name: Thumb-It!
summary:
With Thumb-It! OrangePixel moves away from traditional game controls and targets a new generation of mobile gamers. Taking some of the game concepts from console dance games, Thumb-It! features a gameplay that targets both casual as well as hardcore gamers. Using the 1,3,4 and 6 numbers on your phone you have to press them at the right time to increase your score and continue the game.

As time progresses the challenge increases as numbers start to follow each other more rapidly and the player has to have a good eye-hand coordination to play at the higher levels.
